title: Fix nested unnumbered season folders collapsing onto the first one
body:
When a series' season folders carry no parsable season number, `CreateSeasonsAsync` matches every episode to the first of them by `IndexNumber`, so all episodes are listed under one folder and the rest appear empty.

**Changes**
Resolve each episode's season from the folder it actually lives in (via `FindSeasonId()`), falling back to the index-number lookup only for episodes that are not inside a season folder.
